content.text:
The site looks right again. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass against the approved screenshots.

Three values in `site/css/styles.css` had been changed from their Bootstrap defaults:

- **Card images (line 4276):** `.card-img-top` had `width: 50%`, so the product images only filled half of each card. I set it back to `100%`.
- **Headings (line 119):** `line-height` was `0.6`, which made two-line titles like "Fancy Product" overlap. I set it back to `1.2`.
- **Desktop width (line 661):** the `.container` max-width at 1200px and up was `1710px`, so the content ran wider than the approved layout. I set it back to `1140px`.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
